paragraphs.text: Counting whales from ships or aircraft is expensive and only possible in good weather. Marine biologists in Norway are testing a different method: listening for them.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: The team has placed 25 underwater microphones, known as hydrophones, along the coast. Each species of whale produces a distinctive pattern of calls, so a computer program can identify which whales are nearby and roughly how many there are.
paragraphs.label: B

paragraphs.text: The recordings have already produced a surprise. Humpback whales, which were thought to leave the area in November, were heard calling near the coast until the end of January.
paragraphs.label: C

paragraphs.text: The main difficulty is noise from ships, which can drown out whale calls. The researchers are now training the software to separate the two sounds, and they hope the system will run without human help by next year.
paragraphs.label: D

paragraphs.text: If the trial is successful, the method could be used to monitor whales in other northern seas, where ships and aircraft rarely travel in winter.
paragraphs.label: E

items.quote: Marine biologists in Norway are testing a different method
items.prompt: In which country are biologists testing the listening method?

explanation.en: The country is named in paragraph A: “Marine biologists in Norway are testing a different method”. “In which country” needs one name — Norway.
explanation.kk: Ел бірінші абзацта аталған: «Marine biologists in Norway are testing a different method». «In which country» сұрағына бір атау керек — Norway.
explanation.ru: Страна названа в первом абзаце: «Marine biologists in Norway are testing a different method». Вопрос «In which country» требует одно название — Norway.

items.quote: The team has placed 25 underwater microphones
items.prompt: How many underwater microphones has the team placed along the coast?

explanation.en: “The team has placed 25 underwater microphones” → 25. “Microphones” is already in the question, so write only the number.
explanation.kk: «The team has placed 25 underwater microphones» → 25. «Microphones» сөзі сұрақта бар — тек санды жазамыз.
explanation.ru: «The team has placed 25 underwater microphones» → 25. Слово «microphones» уже в вопросе — пишем только число.

items.prompt: What are the underwater microphones known as?

explanation.en: “underwater microphones, known as hydrophones” → hydrophones, plural as in the text.
explanation.kk: «underwater microphones, known as hydrophones» → hydrophones, мәтіндегідей көпше түрде.
explanation.ru: «underwater microphones, known as hydrophones» → hydrophones, во множественном числе, как в тексте.

items.quote: which were thought to leave the area in November
items.prompt: In which month were humpback whales previously thought to leave the area?

explanation.en: “were thought to leave the area in November” → November. January is when they were actually heard; the question asks what was believed.
explanation.kk: «were thought to leave the area in November» → November. January — оларды шын мәнінде естіген уақыт; сұрақ бұрынғы болжам туралы.
explanation.ru: «were thought to leave the area in November» → November. January — когда их слышали на самом деле; вопрос о прежнем мнении.

items.quote: The main difficulty is noise from ships, which can drown out whale calls
items.prompt: Noise from which source can drown out whale calls?

explanation.en: “noise from ships, which can drown out whale calls” → ships. “Noise” is in the question, so the answer is only the source.
explanation.kk: «noise from ships, which can drown out whale calls» → ships. «Noise» сұрақта бар, жауапқа тек дыбыс көзі жазылады.
explanation.ru: «noise from ships, which can drown out whale calls» → ships. «Noise» уже в вопросе, в ответ идёт только источник.
